assembly_sequence.minimum_QA: Identity and receipt record; counts by route 97 local-fabricate, 568 buy-standard, 29 buy-qualified.
assembly_sequence.operation: Receive 74 unique part definitions; verify 694 pieces, lots/serials, material/finish and purchased certificates. Quarantine missing safety or bearing/belt evidence.

assembly_sequence.minimum_QA: CMM or calibrated gauge report; controlled limits currently absent, so hold fit.
assembly_sequence.operation: Fixture 3 m backplate and 2.9 m guide against controlled aperture/header datums; measure hole pattern, straightness and body mounting load path.

assembly_sequence.minimum_QA: Capture fits, bearing preload/endplay, retention, belt pitch/tension, closed route and all stop positions; no limits yet.
assembly_sequence.operation: Build four carriages with eight rollers/axles/bearings and sixteen roller circlips; add two pulley bearings, drive/idler, 5.8 m belt cut, tensioner, two clamps, four stops and four bottom guides.

assembly_sequence.minimum_QA: Record every torque/retention, weld/bond process where used, body reaction and actual installed mass/CG; no release until independently reviewed.
assembly_sequence.operation: Join operator to supported car aperture with 24 main and 24 guide bolt/nut pairs plus counted ancillary fasteners; install two independently supported leaves and separate glazing assemblies.

assembly_sequence.minimum_QA: Measure electrical route, flex bend, connector retention, isolation/protection, bond continuity, voltage/current/thermal duty and safety logic.
assembly_sequence.operation: Fit motor/controller, two drag chains, two trailing looms, body loom, two bonds, closed/locked/release and obstruction sensors, manual release. Segregate and label circuits.

assembly_sequence.minimum_QA: Record occupied sweep at intermediate poses, access clearances, damage, replacement time, post-repair alignment and repeated function; all acceptance limits require approval.
assembly_sequence.operation: Cycle finite full travel both directions, verify stops/seals/threshold, then execute one supported removal/reinstallation trial through actual access opening with tools and lifting aid.

joint_inventory.joint_retention: torque, lock method, service access, pull-out and fatigue unverified
joint_inventory.sliding_guides: one upper guide stock plus four bottom guides; actual guide/carriage sliding interfaces and friction unverified

make_buy.scope: Named component material/process allowances only, not material-only value, quote, installed cost or domestic value added.

supplier_criticality.buy-qualified: High: belt, bearings, motor/reducer, safety sensors and electronics need approved origin, duty and replacement route
supplier_criticality.buy-standard: Medium: standard fixings still need grade, retention, corrosion and availability verification
supplier_criticality.local-fabricate: Process-critical: guide/roller fits, backplate distortion, bracket datums, wire-harness build and recorded QA

make_buy.tooling: 3 m backplate/2.9 m guide datum fixture, drill/fit gauge, torque/crimp test tools, protected lift support; design/rating/cost unknown

minimum_physical_tests: Full-size single opening fixture: metrology of aperture/header/guide/pulley axes, hole pattern, stack and assembled mass/CG.
Door dynamic cycle over specified duty and temperature with force, speed, current, losses and motor/controller heat, including repeated station service.
Worst-case finite swept clearance with seals, 0..0.72 m leaf motion, stop compliance, wiring flex, platform interface, tool and extraction path.
Obstruction, closed/locked, manual release, loss of supply, degraded modes and train movement interlock fault-injection with independent review.
Retention/strength/fatigue under passenger crowd, emergency and vibration loads; bearing/guide/belt wear and corrosion/environmental exposure.
Timed replacement with local tools and two-person/rated-lift plan; verify access, replacement source, post-repair inspections and continued accessibility.
removal_sequence: Secure car and isolate door supply; prove no stored electrical or mechanical energy and support each leaf.
Open guarded header access; photograph and identify loom/chain/bond positions, connectors, retention and controlled fastener torques.
Disconnect labelled electrical connectors and bonds while preserving manual release; release belt tension under controlled procedure and support moving leaves.
Remove supported leaves and separately owned glazing only as approved; unbolt motor/operator/guide with rated lift, using measured tool and extraction swept envelopes.
Fit replacement with lot/serial record, remeasure datums, torque/retention, bonds, sensor setup, finite motion and locked/obstruction/release functions before return to service.
